subject: Re: appointment reminder
text:
Hi again,

Thanks for the note earlier. I’m just sending this reminder because I know these slots move fast, and I’m still hoping to keep Thursday at 3:00. If the technician changes, could the same time on Friday work instead? I can meet at the usual place, and I already have the parts list ready. I really appreciated how quickly you replied last week, so I wanted to avoid another mix-up with the invoice code. Let me know before Tuesday if possible.
